approval_status: DRAFT — clinical supervisor + institutional/ERC review pending
clinical_population: Adults, pregnancy, children; child minimum age and research eligibility NOT approved
usage: Assisted intake and prototype demonstration, not diagnosis or autonomous triage
answer_policy: Never guess, invent, infer from images, or default unanswered clinical questions to No.
privacy: Coded patient/session IDs; collect minimum necessary data; real collection requires approved consent and technical safeguards.
branch_conditions: Conditions evaluate patient profile and previously entered answers. Unanswered trigger = no inferred condition.

questions.prompt: Study-specific coded patient reference (do not enter a name).
Age in completed months (for children) or derived from age in years.
questions.note: Use age in months to support age-appropriate branching; no child minimum age has been approved.

questions.prompt: Date and value of last laboratory Hb (include units).

For each medicine/supplement: name, strength, dose, route, frequency, start/stop date, reason, last dose, source of information.
For each Ayurvedic/herbal product: name, known ingredients, form, amount, frequency, duration, and concurrent medicines.
For each allergy/adverse reaction: substance, reaction, severity, approximate date and verification status.
Name or coded relationship of parent/guardian to child (do not store identifying names in demo).

Has age-appropriate assent been considered and documented where applicable?
Any concerns about growth, development or activity compared with usual?
Is there a history of prematurity or relevant neonatal illness?
Any feeding difficulties or restrictions?
Any clinician-diagnosed chronic disease or recurrent infection?
For infants/toddlers: current breastfeeding/formula and complementary feeding pattern.
For older children: school-age diet patterns and any limitations in age-appropriate activity.
Estimated gestational week / trimester, if known.
